result.instructions: Tools for GoTable, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tables are free for 4 guests this Saturday evening?"; "List all confirmed reservations for tomorrow with the guest comments and allergies."; "Which guests visited us 5 times or more but not in the last 3 months?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GoTable data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gotable_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gotable_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gotable_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. gotable_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gotable_list_restaurants
tools.title: List restaurants
tools.description: List the restaurants this API key can access (id, name, address, time zone, currency). Call this first: every other tool needs a restaurant_id. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants.

tools.name: gotable_get_restaurant
tools.title: Get a restaurant
tools.description: Get one restaurant by id. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}.

tools.name: gotable_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts of a restaurant
tools.description: List the staff accounts that have access to a restaurant (id, name, e-mail). The account id is the author_id that gotable_create_reservation_note needs. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/accounts.

tools.name: gotable_get_availability
tools.title: Get availability
tools.description: Get the real-time availability of a restaurant per date: closed flag and the time slots with the minimum and maximum party size. The range is capped at 3 months after `from`. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/availability.

till.description: End date yyyy-mm-dd (max 3 months after from).

tools.name: gotable_get_offer_availability
tools.title: Get availability of an offer
tools.description: Get the availability per date of one offer (for example a tasting menu). GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/offers/{offer_id}/availability.

till.description: End date yyyy-mm-dd (max 3 months after from).

tools.name: gotable_list_offers
tools.title: List offers
tools.description: List the offers of a restaurant (deposit per guest, visibility, booking window, translations). GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/offers.

tools.name: gotable_get_offer
tools.title: Get an offer
tools.description: Get one offer by id. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/offers/{offer_id}.

tools.name: gotable_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: Search the reservations of a restaurant. `query` mixes free text with filters: fields type, offer_id, date, time, starts_at, ends_at, state, party_size, guest_name, guest_email, guest_telephone, comments, duration_in_minutes; operators <= < >= > != = == : ~ !: !~. Example: "John date>=2026-10-19 state=confirmed party_size=2". States: pending, rejected, confirmed, checked_in, checked_out, cancelled, expired, reconfirmed, skipped and others. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/reservations.

query.description: Free text and filters, see the tool description.

tools.name: gotable_get_reservation
tools.title: Get a reservation
tools.description: Get one reservation with state, guest data, tables, payment and notes. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/reservations/{reservation_id}.

tools.name: gotable_list_reservation_notes
tools.title: List notes of a reservation
tools.description: List the internal notes of a reservation. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/reservations/{reservation_id}/notes.

tools.name: gotable_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: Search the guests of a restaurant. `query` mixes free text with filters: fields name, email, telephone, last_visit, visits, reservations; operators <= < >= > != = == : ~ !: !~. Example: "visits>=5". GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/guests.

query.description: Free text and filters, see the tool description.

tools.name: gotable_get_guest
tools.title: Get a guest
tools.description: Get one guest with visits, last visit, diets, allergies and tags. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/guests/{guest_id}.

tools.name: gotable_list_tables
tools.title: List tables
tools.description: List the tables of a restaurant (label, section, minimum and maximum party size). GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/tables.

tools.name: gotable_list_combinations
tools.title: List table combinations
tools.description: List the table combinations of a restaurant (groups of tables that seat one larger party). GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/combinations.

tools.name: gotable_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews
tools.description: List the guest reviews of a restaurant (rating, text, state). Needs the `reviews` feature in the GoTable plan; else the API returns an error. GoTable API: GET /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/reviews.

tools.name: gotable_create_reservation
tools.title: Create a reservation
tools.description: WRITE: create a reservation as the restaurant (skips most availability checks, so check gotable_get_availability first). Needs date and time, or type WalkIn for a guest at the door. By default GoTable e-mails and texts the guest: set skip_email / skip_sms to stop that. Not idempotent: a repeat call creates a second reservation. GoTable API: POST /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/reservations.

date.description: Date yyyy-mm-dd (required unless type is WalkIn).

time.description: Time HH:MM (required unless type is WalkIn).

type.description: WalkIn = guest at the door; date and time default to now.

table_lock.description: true = pin the tables, no auto-assignment.

skip_email.description: true = do not send the e-mail to the guest.

skip_sms.description: true = do not send the text message to the guest.

tools.name: gotable_update_reservation
tools.title: Update a reservation
tools.description: WRITE: change the details of a reservation (date, time, party size, guest data, comments, duration, tables). Send only the fields to change. GoTable API: PUT /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/reservations/{reservation_id}.

tools.name: gotable_cancel_reservation
tools.title: Cancel a reservation
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a reservation as the restaurant. By default GoTable e-mails and texts the guest: set skip_email / skip_sms to stop that. GoTable API: POST /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/reservations/{reservation_id}/cancel.

skip_email.description: true = do not send the e-mail to the guest.

skip_sms.description: true = do not send the text message to the guest.

tools.name: gotable_create_reservation_note
tools.title: Add a note to a reservation
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a reservation. author_id is a staff account id (from gotable_list_accounts). Not idempotent. GoTable API: POST /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/reservations/{reservation_id}/notes.

annotations.title: Add a note to a reservation

tools.name: gotable_create_guest
tools.title: Create a guest
tools.description: WRITE: add a guest to the guest book of a restaurant. Not idempotent. GoTable API: POST /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/guests.

subscribed.description: true = the guest accepts marketing e-mail.

tools.name: gotable_update_guest
tools.title: Update a guest
tools.description: WRITE: change the name, e-mail, telephone or marketing consent of a guest. Send only the fields to change. GoTable API: PATCH /api/v1/restaurants/{restaurant_id}/guests/{guest_id}.
